name: The Index

source.note: A side quest boss of our own (The Drowned Library, docs/story/side_quests.md): the great catalogue desk of Khazan's flooded library under Lake Baratok, which was never a desk. Built up from the 2025 Monster Manual's mimic to CR 9 at Huge: a bite, long pseudopods that hold three at once, a spray of acid-soaked pages, Legendary Resistance and two Legendary Actions, and lair actions as the shelves come down and the lake comes in. Drawn with the mimic's sprite, made Huge.

traits.name: Adhesive
traits.summary: Anything it touches sticks; pseudopod hits grapple.
traits.text: The Index adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature its pseudopods hit is Grappled.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.summary: Twice a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When the Index fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead, twice a day.

traits.name: The Catalogue
traits.summary: It has been the library's catalogue desk for three hundred years, and it has eaten every reader but one.
traits.text: Khazan's apprentices sat at the great desk to look things up. It looked them up too. Every drawer is full of a reader's things, filed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The Index makes one Bite attack and two Pseudopod attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Acid damage.

actions.name: Pseudopod
actions.summary: A long arm of varnished wood that sticks; the target is Grappled (escape DC 16).
actions.text: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 16).

actions.name: Spray of Pages
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6: a spray of acid-soaked pages at three creatures within 30 ft; DC 15 Dex save, 5d8 Acid, half on a success.
actions.text: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, up to three creatures within 30 feet. Failure: 22 (5d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.

options.name: Shift
options.summary: Slides up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

lair_actions.name: The Shelves Come Down
lair_actions.summary: Two creatures it can sense: a sodden bookcase comes down on each; DC 15 Dex save, 2d10 Bludgeoning and Prone, half on a success.
lair_actions.text: The library's shelves are rotten through. Two of them topple onto creatures the Index can sense: each makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 11 (2d10) Bludgeoning damage and falling Prone on a failure, or half the damage only on a success.

lair_actions.name: The Lake Comes In
lair_actions.summary: One creature: black lake water bursts through the wall onto it; DC 15 Str save, 3d8 Cold and pushed 10 ft, half on a success.
lair_actions.text: The lake pushes through a crack in the wall onto one creature: it makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw, taking 13 (3d8) Cold damage and being pushed 10 feet on a failure, or half the damage only on a success.

summary: The great catalogue desk of Khazan's flooded library under Lake Baratok: lacquered oak, brass handles, a hundred little drawers, and none of it a desk. It has eaten every reader but one, and filed their things.
